run_location: server2203 public-only; independent new run directory

inputs.reference: SS03 public 64Hz SparrKULee train manifest + frozen train-only normalization

windowing.sequence_target: 20 nonoverlapping 3s windows form one 60s continuous record segment
windowing.causality: inter-window history causal; intra-window encoder uses complete 3s offline EEG

structure.parameter_matching_limit: within 2.78% only; active parameter/FLOP/latency not guaranteed equal

public_eeg_protocol.first_gate: read-only metadata audit: grouping by source_family or story is feasible and leak-free
public_eeg_protocol.split: new heldout derived solely from SS03 train pool and frozen before fitting; prospective INTERNAL only, not external replication
public_eeg_protocol.lag_selection: training/validation only; no SS03 test scores
public_eeg_protocol.primary: 60s segment Pearson -> subject macro; both actual history contribution and model-quality gain
public_eeg_protocol.training: bounded one-seed training/validation pilot then freeze seeds, compute budget and validation rules before prospective internal holdout evaluation
public_eeg_protocol.stop: Do not start SS04 or publish artifact from SS05 without new decision
